## Propose change to an existing glossary term

Thanks for helping to improve the [advISO Glossary of Terms](https://adviso-glossary.readthedocs.io/en/latest/glossary.html)! Please complete as many sections as you can. A maintainer will review the suggestion and help refine the wording before any change is made.

Before you start, please check open issues to see whether a change to this term has already been proposed.

---

### Term
*The term as it currently appears in the glossary.*

### Type of change
- [ ] Correction (factual error or inaccuracy)
- [ ] Clarification (wording is unclear or ambiguous)
- [ ] Update (reflects a newer version of a standard or current practice)
- [ ] Addition (new example, bioinformatics translation or ontological reference)
- [ ] Typo, spelling or formatting
- [ ] Removal or merge with another term
- [ ] Other

### Which part of the entry should change?
- [ ] Term name or abbreviation
- [ ] Definition (ISO / wet-lab context)
- [ ] Example usage (wet-lab)
- [ ] Bioinformatics translation
- [ ] Example usage (bioinformatics)
- [ ] Ontological references
- [ ] Source standard or clause reference

### Current text
*Copy the wording you would like to change from the glossary.*


### Proposed text
*Your suggested replacement wording.*


### Reason for the change
*Explain why the change is needed, e.g. the current definition conflicts with ISO 15189:2022, the bioinformatics translation is misleading, or the example does not reflect common practice.*


### Related glossary terms (optional)
*Other entries that may need updating for consistency, or that this term should cross-reference.*


---

### Checklist
- [ ] I have checked open issues, and this change has not already been proposed.
- [ ] Proposed wording is my own and does not reproduce copyrighted text.
- [ ] I am happy for this content to be edited and published as part of the advISO Glossary of Terms.
